DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

The specific clinical presentation of sudden-onset vertigo lasting approximately three minutes, accompanied by nausea and vomiting, is highly characteristic of BPPV. While the phrase "with perspicacious discernment" contained in your statement is not medically relevant data, the symptoms you described align perfectly with this diagnosis.
